label: Order
caption: Order of the Court
text: IT IS ORDERED that the revised Rules of this Court, approved by the Court and lodged with the Clerk, shall be effective January 1, 2023, and that the amended provisions shall be printed as an appendix to the United States Reports. IT IS FURTHER ORDERED that the Rules promulgated April 18, 2019, see 587 U.S. ___, shall be rescinded as of December 31, 2022, and that the revised Rules shall govern all proceedings after their effective date except to the extent that, in the opinion of the Court, their application to a pending matter would not be feasible or would work an injustice, in which event the former procedure applies.
